from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics for a single company's filing for the evaluation period."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    report_date: Optional[str] = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD or similar format")
    
    # Net Income (Year-over-Year Comparison)
    net_income_current: Optional[float] = Field(description="Consolidated Net Income amount for the most recent period")
    net_income_current_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="Description of the period for current net income")
    net_income_current_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit scale for current net income (e.g., 'million', 'thousand')")
    
    net_income_prior: Optional[float] = Field(description="Consolidated Net Income amount for the comparable prior period")
    net_income_prior_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="Description of the period for prior net income")
    net_income_prior_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit scale for prior net income")
    
    # Cash and Cash Equivalents (Period-over-Period Comparison)
    cash_current: Optional[float] = Field(description="Cash and Cash Equivalents amount at end of current period")
    cash_current_date: Optional[str] = Field(description="Date of the current cash balance")
    cash_current_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit scale for current cash (e.g., 'million', 'thousand')")
    
    cash_prior: Optional[float] = Field(description="Cash and Cash Equivalents amount at end of prior comparable period")
    cash_prior_date: Optional[str] = Field(description="Date of the prior cash balance")
    cash_prior_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit scale for prior cash")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
